integrity: The infinite theorem is proved by an exact modular argument and finite graph classification. The accompanying computation is only corroborative. The cited 2026 source supplies existence for squarefree denominators and is not treated as independent validation of this refinement.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies exactly the length-three layer for prime reciprocals. When the factorization criterion fails it proves only that the minimum length is at least four; it does not determine the exact larger minimum or a density of qualifying primes. The originality search cannot rule out unindexed folklore for this elementary graph argument.
title: Three-term semiprime Egyptian representations of prime reciprocals
